spans.s: फु(फू)त् ind. (used only in composition with the root कृ) An onomatopoetic word imitative of the sound made by blowing into liquids &c.; (sometimes it expresses disregard or contempt).

फु(फू)त्-कार म्।, -कृत न्।, -कृति ऋ। m. 1. hissing; 2. the hiss of a serpent; 3. screaming, shouting; 4. sobbing.
